name: Hagar
title: Mother of Ishmael
summary: Hagar was an Egyptian slave who belonged to Sarah. When Sarah was childless, she gave Hagar to Abraham as a secondary wife. Hagar bore Ishmael but was later sent away with her son. In the wilderness, she met God, who saw her distress and promised that Ishmael would become a great nation.

keyEvents.title: Given to Abraham
keyEvents.description: Sarah gave her Egyptian slave Hagar to Abraham as a secondary wife because she herself was childless.

keyEvents.title: Flight from Sarah
keyEvents.description: When Hagar became pregnant, she despised Sarah. Sarah treated her harshly, and Hagar fled into the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: God Sees
keyEvents.description: The angel of the Lord found Hagar at a spring and promised that her son would become the ancestor of a great nation. She called God 'A God who sees'.

keyEvents.title: Birth of Ishmael
keyEvents.description: Hagar gave birth to Ishmael when Abraham was 86 years old.

keyEvents.title: Sent Away
keyEvents.description: After Isaac's birth, Hagar and Ishmael were sent away. In the wilderness, God gave them water and promised to make Ishmael into a great nation.
